title: Recover pending intent across host loss
summary: Explore provider-neutral recovery of an interrupted authorized operation when the original host disappears. Compare retained tickets with repository-native evidence; distinguish same-intent recovery from new intent, and never replay an uncertain mutation.

origin.source: Owner-directed VIB engineering research and independent implementation discussion, 2026-11-25; source-level provenance retained separately.

benefits: Reduces abandoned work without losing issue identity
risks: Remote persistence may expose data or add contention; no mandatory service, automatic reassignment or exactly-once claim

evidence.claim: Existing VIB candidate context only; does not establish implementation or acceptance of this idea.
